vertical: final bearer/raw -> typed Native witness -> fresh session.create -> same-Tx durable initial-writer origin
root_schema_backup_paths_to_reserve_sepa: prepared addon loader/fingerprint/typed-validator/backup guard exact paths from schema owner's scope
private_witness_storage: immutable bounded in-memory map owned by current Host; never serialized or reconstructed from ordinary DB labels
private_marker: separate closed private-command-envelope v2 header with native_create_attestation marker; old private v1 and public schema unchanged

ports.native_producer: func (h *Host) nativeClientAttest(ctx context.Context, invocation nativeInvocation) ([]byte, func(), error)
ports.native_credential_resolver: func (s *Service) ResolveNativeCreateCredential(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, token, project string) (NativeCreateCredential, error)
ports.consumer_authority: type NativeCreateAuthority interface { VerifyNativeCreate(context.Context, *sql.Tx, NativeCreateProofQuery) (VerifiedNativeCreateOrigin, error) }
ports.source_grant_hook: private recordNativeCreateOrigin after validated COMPLETED result and original v1 identity sealing, then origin insert -> checked private-v2 marker CAS -> pair revalidation, before API commit, in the same transaction

root_adopted_safeguards: foreign attach for origin-bearing sessions is rejected for live/expired/null lease before legacy fallback
old sessions and goal.start remain legacy with no automatic Native backfill
marked v2 allowed only for COMPLETED create with exactly one origin; no marked REJECTED/direct v2 insert; a missing relation is an integrity error
adopted schema with missing table/invariant is integrity failure, not no-origin
cold/restore witness loss does not erase consumption or unlock legacy downgrade
ordinary sealed COMPLETED replay never consumes a witness or creates a new session/grant/event
Native operation never bootstraps/renews/issues/revokes a credential
no old resource/UNKNOWN approval scope is read or replayed
schema_adoption: Prepared addon only, no ordinary version24 ceiling/startup change; never-adopted is unsupported, adopted/marked missing or drift is integrity failure. Root must pin exact reservation and client enablement.
